overview: Hierarchy-dLLM proposes a training-free hierarchical parallel decoding framework for diffusion large language models that recursively partitions masked spans into smaller sub-decoding areas using divide-and-conquer, decoding tokens via progressive confidence thresholds (high→low→global fallback) with remasking correction, achieving up to 17× speedup over vanilla decoding while maintaining comparable accuracy.

modules.name: Masked Diffusion Model Inference Engine
modules.description: Core dLLM forward pass abstraction: handles masked token prediction, bidirectional attention context computation, and the reverse denoising process from fully masked sequences. Provides model posterior probability outputs for all masked positions given a partially corrupted sequence.

modules.name: Masking Strategy Generator
modules.description: Generates two masking patterns for analysis—Consecutive Mask (contiguous block of masked tokens) and Sparse Mask (scattered masked positions interleaved with unmasked anchors). Serves both the preliminary KL divergence study and the hierarchical decoding partition logic.

modules.name: KL Divergence Analysis Module
modules.description: Implements the approximate KL divergence computation between stepwise decoding (ground truth) and one-pass parallel decoding. Computes the cross-entropy surrogate using argmax one-hot targets from stepwise logits against softmax one-pass predictions, supporting both stepwise-vs-once and ground-truth-vs-once comparison modes.

modules.name: Confidence Score Calculator
modules.description: Computes per-position confidence scores as the maximum posterior probability over the vocabulary for each masked token. Provides confidence ranking, threshold comparisons, and identification of the globally most confident position across the entire sequence.

modules.name: Progressive Relaxation Token Selection
modules.description: Implements the three-tier decoding decision logic within each sub-decoding area: (1) commit all tokens exceeding the high confidence threshold, (2) if none qualify, commit the single most confident token above the low threshold, (3) if still none, globally commit the most confident token across the entire block. Ensures at least one token is decoded per iteration.

modules.name: Remasking Correction Module
modules.description: Re-evaluates all decoded tokens after each decoding step and replaces any token whose confidence has dropped below the remasking threshold with the mask symbol. Prevents error accumulation by allowing previously committed but now unreliable tokens to be re-decoded in subsequent iterations with richer context.

modules.name: Sub-decoding Area Partitioner
modules.description: Given a block with newly decoded anchor tokens, identifies all contiguous spans of remaining masked tokens and splits them into independent sub-decoding areas. Each span bounded by decoded tokens or block boundaries becomes a separate area for parallel processing in the next iteration.

modules.name: Hierarchical Decoding Orchestrator
modules.description: Top-level controller implementing the divide-and-conquer loop: initializes each block as a full masked span, iterates through decode→remask→partition cycles within each block, manages parallel processing across multiple sub-decoding areas, and terminates when all tokens in a block are decoded.

modules.name: Semi-Autoregressive Block Scheduler
modules.description: Manages the block-level generation schedule (SADD): divides the total generation length into fixed-size blocks, processes blocks sequentially left-to-right, and invokes the hierarchical decoding orchestrator for each block. Controls block length and the number of blocks for the generation task.

modules.name: Naive Parallel Decoding Baseline
modules.description: Implements vanilla parallel decoding that samples a fixed number of tokens per step based on a target parallel factor, without spatial partitioning or hierarchical structure. Used as a comparison baseline to demonstrate Hierarchy-dLLM's superior accuracy–efficiency trade-off.

modules.name: Efficiency Metrics Computation
modules.description: Calculates tokens per forward call (TPF, excluding EOS token) and throughput per second (TPS, excluding EOS token). Tracks the number of function evaluations (NFE), wall-clock time per sample, and speedup ratios relative to baseline methods.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: End-to-end evaluation harness supporting GSM8K and MATH500 (mathematical reasoning), HumanEval and MBPP (code generation), and IF-Eval (instruction following). Integrates with the lm-eval library, applies few-shot prompting, and reports Pass@1 accuracy alongside efficiency metrics.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Configurable ablation runner supporting: (1) generation length variation (short/medium/long), (2) block length variation (small/medium/large), (3) threshold sensitivity analysis (sweeping high and low thresholds independently), (4) remasking on/off comparison, (5) comparison between hierarchical decoding and naive parallel decoding at matched TPF levels.

modules.name: Hyperparameter Grid Search
modules.description: Systematic search over the three key thresholds: high threshold, low threshold, and remasking threshold. Generates performance and efficiency curves across the search space, identifies the flat optimal region, and selects the best configuration balancing accuracy and speed.

modules.name: Visualization and Profiling Suite
modules.description: Generates: (1) color-coded token-level decoding step visualizations for case studies on GSM8K and HumanEval, (2) KL divergence curves comparing masking strategies, (3) threshold sensitivity plots (score and TPS vs. threshold), (4) score-vs-TPF Pareto frontiers comparing methods, (5) inference time breakdown pie charts showing model forward pass vs. token selection overhead.
